confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of UK south-coast resort pricing, not live listings or inspected booking pages. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are the most reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain. Cocktail and wine use the usual UK pub-to-cocktail and wine-to-beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak season in Brighton and rates vary widely by location and date. USD figures assume a GBP/USD rate of roughly 1.30 to 1.35. FX caveat: the source_rate came from a search-result summary that referenced the RBA exchange rates page, and I did not open that page directly. A second search could not corroborate the 15 October 2026 figure, so verify the rate against RBA table F11.1 before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other English south-coast seaside cities and provincial UK resort towns with similar tourism demand and price levels, adjusted upward for Brighton's summer peak-season accommodation premium.
